companies.description:
Role Overview We are seeking exceptional early-career software engineers who aspire to build the next generation of AI-native software platforms, reusable software IP and intelligent enterprise solutions. As an Elite Technology Engineer you will combine strong full-stack engineering foundations with AI-first development practices to create production-grade software, domain-specific AI capabilities and reusable engineering assets that power the future of enterprise technology. You will work on real client programmes across industries, designing and delivering AI-native applications using modern cloud platforms, AI-assisted development tools and software engineering best practices. Working alongside architects, product teams and AI specialists, you will help shape intelligent, scalable and continuously evolving software solutions. This role provides accelerated learning through structured AI certification pathways, exposure to leading AI ecosystems and hands-on experience developing reusable AI capabilities that create long-term client value.

companies.description:
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

Job Description
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

companies.description:
About Accenture Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com. About the role : Skill - Strategy & Consulting Level - CL 12 - Associate Location - Gurugram/New Delhi/Mumbai/Bangalore/Kolkata/ Pune/Hyderabad/Chennai as applicable Travel Percentage - Expected Travel could be anywhere between 0-100% Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role: You will be working with our team of experts who work on the right scalable solutions and services that help our clients achieve their business objectives faster. This includes assisting your team in the following – 1. Identifying, assessing, and solving complex business problems for area of responsibility, where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. 2. Identifying a client’s high-level business needs and in the creation of detailed functional specs and other documentation, such as requirement traceability matrices, work-flow diagrams, and use-cases 3. Defining how our clients can leverage new technologies for greatest strategic impact in the digital world that supports business requirements and reduces costs 4. Solving key business problems and challenges by painting a picture of, and charting a journey from the current state to a “to-be” enterprise environment 5. Developing detailed and actionable business cases and plans which reflect our practice’s deep industry, Digital and business process acumen to leverage technology for greatest strategic impact. 6. Working in multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate, and implement programs. 7. Assisting our clients build the required capabilities for growth and innovation to sustain high performance. 8. Reimagine, build, and transform client business and operations by developing cutting edge assets, tool and methodologies, development of PoVs, research, white papers, support development of Go-to- market offerings. Your experience counts! 1. BE/B.Tech from Tier-1 institute. 2. Academic excellence - Demonstrate consistency throughout academic career. 3. Knowledge of Microsoft tools - PowerPoint, Excel, Word & MS Project 4. Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) along with any other foreign language is a plus. 5. Strategic and analytical thinker, effective and proactive problem solver 6. Aptitude to learn, problem solving, ability to think creatively to solve real global business problems. 7. Ability to seamlessly integrate and work collaboratively in fast-paced global environment. 8. Competence in building credibility and effective relationships with stakeholders Must have skills: • Knowledge of tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Microsoft Axis, Azure, AWS or any other data visualization platform • Proficiency in Japanese, German, French and Italian Language is a plus. • Effective presentation development and delivery skills to diverse stakeholders • Demonstrated leadership skills in projects or any other allied activities (e.g., college clubs, pro-bono volunteering) • Knowledge of programming language C++, Java, R, S-Plus, Python or another niche technical capability • Knowledge on key technology implementation solutions including MES, SAP, IOT, Analytics • Knowledge on after-market service operations including spare parts management, warranty management is a plus • Curiosity about AI and its business applications; willingness to build AI fluency on the job • Familiarity with AI/GenAI tools or platforms What’s in it for you? 1. An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients 2. Potential to co-create with strategy leaders, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, BI professionals to innovate solutions that leverage emerging technologies 3. Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen while growing your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities 4. Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization. Disclaimer 1. Accenture is committed to providing veteran job opportunities to our service men and women. 2. Accenture is an equal opportunity employer and I&D is a critical part of our talent agenda for PWD and LGBTQ candidates. 3. All selection decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. 4. Please take note that, unless there is a formal offer of employment from Accenture, any communication made by Accenture in respect of open position/selection process or steps related thereto shall not be assumed or treated to be as a commitment or an offer of employment or guarantee of employment with Accenture 5. At Accenture, the health and well-being of our people, our clients and the community is our top priority. We are also committed to complying with all government safety protocols as we bring our people to our offices. Before onboarding, we strongly encourage you to take both doses of the COVID-19 vaccine as per government prescribed timelines. 6. Accenture has not authorized any agency, company or individual to either collect money or arrive on any monetary arrangement in exchange for a job at Accenture. Accenture's criterion for hiring candidates is merit. Any agency, company or individual offering employment with Accenture in exchange for money is misrepresenting their relationship with Accenture, which has not authorized any such action. If you are approached by any entity or individuals who demand money or any other form of compensation in return for a job offer at Accenture – even if they present themselves as representatives or employees of Accenture – please send the details to Accenture Business Ethics Line https://businessethicsline.com/accenture or india.fc.check@accenture.com 7. Accenture has not authorized its officials to either collect money, benefit(s) and or favour(s) of any kind from the college Placement committee, student body and or college administration for participating in campus recruitment events at the time of confirming Accenture’s participation in the same

About the company	AIRA Matrix provides artificial intelligence based solutions for Life Sciences applications. Our solutions improve efficiency, diagnostic accuracy, and turnaround times in pathology, microbiology and ophthalmology workflows across pharmaceutical and healthcare laboratories. We leverage machine and deep learning techniques to develop diagnostic, prognostic, and predictive solutions. Our solutions provide cost benefits in the pharmaceutical domain, by speeding up pre-clinical drug development timelines, and by enhancing the efficiency of environmental monitoring required in manufacturing. In healthcare applications, our solutions improve treatment outcomes by aiding disease stratification and enabling management protocols tailored to individual patients. Our clients and partners include leading hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, CROs, and research labs around the world. Our deep learning platforms with existing network models and pre-built AI applications provide the foundation for fast customizations and help tackle any unique challenges in your image analysis and study management workflows. Our flexible service model enables the swift deployment of these custom solutions with minimal resource and time commitment from your side. Our Application Development Team plays an important role in developing competent customer facing applications to access our AI solutions and enterprise-level image management systems in life sciences. It has successfully developed several innovative solutions, such as a one-of-a-kind image viewing platform for histopathology images enabled with digital collaboration, custom web applications with built-in workflows for microbial monitoring, and custom libraries for UI to support unique features and audit traceability across applications among other functionalities. With absolute flexibility to choose and use the latest technologies, our AppDev team comes up with best-in-class enhancements and feature upgrades which are highly appreciated by the customers.

companies.role: Associate Engineer - Industrialisation_Robotics and Data Analytics_UG
companies.description:
Airbus is building the future of aviation, and data is our engine. We are looking for passionate engineering students who want to bridge the gap between physical aerospace hardware and digital intelligence. In this role, you won’t just be coding; you will be applying data-driven insights to real-world industrial challenges—from analyzing sensor data to optimizing shopfloor processes. This involves both developing Data Foundations , AI models and industrializing these algorithms into functional software solutions that our teams can use daily. ● Your Mission : You will join a dynamic project focused on Industry 4.0. You will help us translate raw shopfloor signals into actionable data models and AI to help our engineers make smarter, faster decisions. The Physical Design & Integration (PDI) department is responsible for Electrical System Installation (ESI) & Mechanical System Installation (MSI), Architecture, Integration, Cabin Design, MAP, Configuration Management and automation activities. About the company	Allegro Capital is a leader in healthcare and lifesciences investment banking. Established in Bangalore in 2002, the firm has advised promoters, corporates and global investors on mergers and acquisitions, private equity and growth capital fundraising, and strategic advisory transactions. Our corporate finance team has closed more than 125 deals with a combined value exceeding $23Bn and have advised market-leading companies like Manipal Hospitals, Biocon, Syngene, Narayana Hrudayalaya, Apollo Hospitals, Cloudnine, HCG, Indiabulls (not exhaustive) and globally renowned funds like KKR, TPG, IFC, TrueNorth (not exhaustive). Job Description
An Analyst will be working across the Corporate Finance and Investment Management teams. Analysts will work on company and industry research, business models, investment memos, information memoranda, valuation analyses, etc., and will support both teams on live mandates, prospects, and investment decisions. This is a full-time, work-from-office role based out of our Bangalore office. Who We’re Looking For: Strong interpersonal and communication skills; strong academic record and a keen interest in finance and capital markets; solid analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; ability to manage multiple workstreams and meet tight deadlines; ambitious, intellectually curious, responsible self-starter; prior internship experience in banking, PE, consulting, or equity research is a plus, but not required. What You’ll Gain: Work in a boutique investment bank that has been consistently recognized as a leader in Healthcare & Life Sciences Investment Banking; close mentorship from experienced deal professionals.

About the company	Auronova Consulting is a specialized Risk Management Consulting firm providing cutting edge financial consulting to BFSI segments inclusive of central banks, banks, fintech, investment banks, PE Firms, insurance firms, brokerage, fintech, non-banking finance companies and other financial institutions. We cover the entire Risk Management spectrum from Credit risk, Market risk and Operational risk along with regulatory consulting like Basel II/III, IFRS 9, FRTB, ICAAP, Stress Testing etc. We have served 100+ clients in multiple countries across the globe over the last 10 years with more than 200+ engagements in risk, analytics & compliance area, creating a niche for ourselves by providing our clients best in class solutions, while competing with the best in the industry. Our unique value proposition is to help our clients in designing and implementing a comprehensive analytics program customized to their requirements. We have gained valuable experience over time while working with leading banks and financial institutions across the globe.

companies.description:
Flying Start Graduate Trainee Engineer 2027: Research & Development From “Hamara Bajaj” to “The World’s Favourite Indian,” Bajaj Auto has spent eight decades building motorcycles the world rides. Today that means more than 20 million on roads across 108 countries, over 1,200 patents, and one of Asia’s most advanced automotive R&D centres. We are India’s No.1 motorcycle exporter and home to brands like Pulsar, Dominar, Chetak, KTM and Triumph. Flying Start, our Graduate Trainee Engineer programme, is the talent pipeline behind every function in the company, and several of those functions are now led by engineers who joined as GTEs straight from campus. For 2027, we are inviting final-year engineering students to join R&D at Bajaj Auto Ltd. (BAL) and Bajaj Auto Technology Ltd. (BATL). As an R&D GTE, you will take real products from concept to road. In BAL R&D, you will own vehicle and component design through to production readiness. You will benchmark competitors to set weight, cost and performance targets, build 3D layouts and hard points, and optimise designs through CAE and CFD simulation before a prototype is ever built. You will also plan and run design verification and validation, test components and full vehicles for durability, NVH and ride performance, and support prototype and pilot builds through to SOP. In BATL R&D, you will design, prototype and validate EV hardware and software alongside multidisciplinary teams working on motors, batteries, power electronics and control systems. That work involves applying model-based design and simulation, and analysing test data to make next-generation EVs more efficient, reliable and safe. We are looking for engineers with strong fundamentals in mechanical, automobile, electrical or related disciplines, sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and across teams. Knowledge of vehicle systems and validation methods will serve you well on the vehicle side. On the EV side, a grounding in power electronics, control or embedded systems helps, and familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink, Python/C/C++, PCB design or motor modelling is a plus. In return, you get world-class labs and EV platforms, serious mentorship, early ownership, a culture where filing patents is part of the job, and the pride of seeing your work on roads around the world. As Kamalnayan Bajaj put it, “Do what you think is best but be the best in what you do.” Come help build Hamara Kal, the future of mobility. #JoinTheTribe

Job Description
Flying Start Graduate Trainee Engineer 2027: Research & Development From “Hamara Bajaj” to “The World’s Favourite Indian,” Bajaj Auto has spent eight decades building motorcycles the world rides. Today that means more than 20 million on roads across 108 countries, over 1,200 patents, and one of Asia’s most advanced automotive R&D centres. We are India’s No.1 motorcycle exporter and home to brands like Pulsar, Dominar, Chetak, KTM and Triumph. Flying Start, our Graduate Trainee Engineer programme, is the talent pipeline behind every function in the company, and several of those functions are now led by engineers who joined as GTEs straight from campus. For 2027, we are inviting final-year engineering students to join R&D at Bajaj Auto Ltd. (BAL) and Bajaj Auto Technology Ltd. (BATL). As an R&D GTE, you will take real products from concept to road. In BAL R&D, you will own vehicle and component design through to production readiness. You will benchmark competitors to set weight, cost and performance targets, build 3D layouts and hard points, and optimise designs through CAE and CFD simulation before a prototype is ever built. You will also plan and run design verification and validation, test components and full vehicles for durability, NVH and ride performance, and support prototype and pilot builds through to SOP. In BATL R&D, you will design, prototype and validate EV hardware and software alongside multidisciplinary teams working on motors, batteries, power electronics and control systems. That work involves applying model-based design and simulation, and analysing test data to make next-generation EVs more efficient, reliable and safe. We are looking for engineers with strong fundamentals in mechanical, automobile, electrical or related disciplines, sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and across teams. Knowledge of vehicle systems and validation methods will serve you well on the vehicle side. On the EV side, a grounding in power electronics, control or embedded systems helps, and familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink, Python/C/C++, PCB design or motor modelling is a plus. In return, you get world-class labs and EV platforms, serious mentorship, early ownership, a culture where filing patents is part of the job, and the pride of seeing your work on roads around the world. Our clients invest to achieve meaningful goals—preparing for retirement, funding education, purchasing homes, and building businesses. We are committed to creating an inclusive, collaborative, and forward thinking workplace where individuals are empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive. To learn more, visit www.blackrock.com. About the Aladdin Data Graduate Program The Aladdin Data Graduate Program is designed for recent graduates who are passionate about data, technology, and innovation. As a graduate hire, you will contribute to meaningful, real-world projects that support BlackRock's Aladdin platform—a leading investment management and operations system used by financial institutions around the world. Based on your interests and experience, you may be aligned with one of the following engineering tracks: • Data Engineer: Build scalable data pipelines while supporting data quality, governance, and reliability. • Private Markets Engineer: Develop data and analytics solutions tailored to the unique requirements of private markets. • Product Engineer: Help shape product capabilities and user experiences through data-driven insights and engineering solutions. What You'll Do As a graduate hire, you will have the opportunity to: • Understand business and engineering requirements and translate them into focused, testable AI or data solutions. • Work with structured and unstructured data from databases, APIs, files, documents, and enterprise systems. • Develop prototypes for use cases such as document extraction, information classification, semantic search, retrieval, summarization, and workflow automation. • Prepare data for machine-learning and generative-AI applications through ingestion, transformation, validation, metadata management, and quality checks. • Build and test solutions using technologies such as Python, Java, Spark, data stores, APIs, and relevant AI or natural-language-processing frameworks. • Create evaluation datasets and assess AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, reliability, and common failure patterns. • Add appropriate logging, monitoring, validation, and human-review steps to improve the operational reliability of AI-enabled workflows. • Collaborate with engineers, data specialists, product teams, and other technology partners to refine solutions through feedback and testing. • Document technical decisions, experimental results, limitations, and recommended next steps. • Present your work through demonstrations, design discussions, team forums, hackathons, and innovation challenges. • Take ownership of a defined project from initial exploration through implementation, testing, documentation, and handover. What We're Looking For We welcome applications from graduates who demonstrate: • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine passion for technology and continuous learning. • An understanding of object-oriented design and software development principles. • Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, data engineering frameworks, or related tools—considered an advantage. • Excellent communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills. • A strong commitment to product quality, reliability, and user experience. Learning and Development As an Aladdin Data Graduate Hire, you will benefit from a supportive and engaging learning environment that includes: • Experience within a specialized technology stream, complemented by broader exposure through networking and cross-functional project work. • Access to BlackRock Academies, mentorship programs, career coaching, and professional-development resources. • Opportunities to engage with senior leaders and participate in internal forums, events, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Equal Opportunity Employer BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Job Description
Role – Aladdin Data Engineering Analyst Locations: Gurgaon, Mumbai, and Bangalore, India About BlackRock At BlackRock, our purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients invest to achieve meaningful goals—preparing for retirement, funding education, purchasing homes, and building businesses. These investments also support the global economy by financing infrastructure and driving innovation. Our people are our greatest investment. We are committed to creating an inclusive, collaborative, and forward thinking workplace where individuals are empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive. To learn more, visit www.blackrock.com. About the Aladdin Data Graduate Program The Aladdin Data Graduate Program is designed for recent graduates who are passionate about data, technology, and innovation. As a graduate hire, you will contribute to meaningful, real-world projects that support BlackRock's Aladdin platform—a leading investment management and operations system used by financial institutions around the world. Based on your interests and experience, you may be aligned with one of the following engineering tracks: • Data Engineer: Build scalable data pipelines while supporting data quality, governance, and reliability. • Private Markets Engineer: Develop data and analytics solutions tailored to the unique requirements of private markets. • Product Engineer: Help shape product capabilities and user experiences through data-driven insights and engineering solutions. What You'll Do As a graduate hire, you will have the opportunity to: • Understand business and engineering requirements and translate them into focused, testable AI or data solutions. • Work with structured and unstructured data from databases, APIs, files, documents, and enterprise systems. • Develop prototypes for use cases such as document extraction, information classification, semantic search, retrieval, summarization, and workflow automation. • Prepare data for machine-learning and generative-AI applications through ingestion, transformation, validation, metadata management, and quality checks. • Build and test solutions using technologies such as Python, Java, Spark, data stores, APIs, and relevant AI or natural-language-processing frameworks. • Create evaluation datasets and assess AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, consistency, reliability, and common failure patterns. • Add appropriate logging, monitoring, validation, and human-review steps to improve the operational reliability of AI-enabled workflows. • Collaborate with engineers, data specialists, product teams, and other technology partners to refine solutions through feedback and testing. • Document technical decisions, experimental results, limitations, and recommended next steps. • Present your work through demonstrations, design discussions, team forums, hackathons, and innovation challenges. • Take ownership of a defined project from initial exploration through implementation, testing, documentation, and handover. What We're Looking For We welcome applications from graduates who demonstrate: • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine passion for technology and continuous learning. • An understanding of object-oriented design and software development principles. • Familiarity with artificial intelligence, machine learning, data engineering frameworks, or related tools—considered an advantage. • Excellent communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills. • A strong commitment to product quality, reliability, and user experience. Learning and Development As an Aladdin Data Graduate Hire, you will benefit from a supportive and engaging learning environment that includes: • Experience within a specialized technology stream, complemented by broader exposure through networking and cross-functional project work. • Access to BlackRock Academies, mentorship programs, career coaching, and professional-development resources. • Opportunities to engage with senior leaders and participate in internal forums, events, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Equal Opportunity Employer BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Role – AI & ML Engineer (Aladdin Engineering) Analyst Locations: Gurgaon and Mumbai, India About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s education, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support small and large businesses; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. For additional information on BlackRock, please visit @blackrock | Twitter: @blackrock | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/blackrock Our team is known for: • Being passionate about technology and solving complex problems • Being from diverse industries and academic backgrounds • Developing in Java, Python, Cassandra, Kubernetes, Azure, Kafka, Docker, a host of languages and open-source technologies • Domain SMEs to build, test and provide 24/7 support for Aladdin • Being technology leaders that unlock incremental innovation and drive technology culture at BlackRock What We Are Looking For We seek high-caliber talent with exceptional analytical aptitude, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for solving complex challenges. Successful candidates combine strong quantitative and technical capabilities with the ability to think critically, learn rapidly, and deliver meaningful outcomes in dynamic environments. Candidates should possess: • Outstanding academic achievement and a consistent record of excellence. • Strong analytical, quantitative, and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex challenges from first principles. • Strong foundations in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or related quantitative disciplines. • Understanding of core machine-learning concepts including model training, generalization, feature representation, evaluation, optimization, and experimentation. • Ability to program in Python and familiarity with modern software-engineering practices; exposure to ML frameworks, LLMs, retrieval systems, or AI application development is advantageous. • Ability to reason about probabilistic or non-deterministic systems, design meaningful evaluations, analyze failure modes, and improve solution quality iteratively. • Curiosity and ability to develop expertise across business, technology, and product domains. • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. • A growth mindset, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning and innovation Key Responsibilities • Work on complex, high-impact engineering and business problems spanning AI-native solutions, AI-enabled applications, and foundational engineering that enables broader AI adoption. • Apply data-driven and first-principles thinking to design scalable solutions to business and technology challenges. • Design, build, evaluate and productionize platforms, systems, analytical solutions, models, and workflows that support informed decision-making and deliver measurable impact. • Apply AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI to engineering, testing, design, automation, analytics and business workflows where intelligent capabilities can materially improve outcomes. • Develop deep business and domain knowledge to identify opportunities where technology and AI can create meaningful value • Engineer AI systems beyond the model itself, integrating data pipelines, models, retrieval layers, APIs, tools and application workflows into scalable end-to-end solutions. • Analyze diverse datasets to generate actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful products, processes, and technology solutions. • Contribute to foundational engineering and infrastructure that strengthens scalability, resilience, data readiness, and future AI adoption. • Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and user experiences. • Demonstrate ownership and sound judgment while communicating insights and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. • Explore emerging technologies and bring creativity and fresh thinking to evolving engineering and business challenges. Your Learning & Development You will gain: • Hands-on experience solving complex, high-impact problems across AI-native, AI-enabled and foundational engineering initiatives, while developing deep expertise in the underlying business and technology domains. • Exposure to the development of AI/ML systems from problem formulation and experimentation through evaluation, engineering and production application. • Opportunities to deepen your expertise across software engineering, AI/ML, data, platforms and emerging technologies. • Exposure to BlackRock's culture, leadership, and industry-leading platforms. • Access to structured learning, technical training, career coaching, mentorship, and professional networks. • Opportunities to collaborate with diverse, high-performing teams and solve complex challenges at global scale. BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

Role – AI & ML Engineer (Aladdin Engineering) Analyst Locations: Gurgaon and Mumbai, India About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s education, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support small and large businesses; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. For additional information on BlackRock, please visit @blackrock | Twitter: @blackrock | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/blackrock Our team is known for: • Being passionate about technology and solving complex problems • Being from diverse industries and academic backgrounds • Developing in Java, Python, Cassandra, Kubernetes, Azure, Kafka, Docker, a host of languages and open-source technologies • Domain SMEs to build, test and provide 24/7 support for Aladdin • Being technology leaders that unlock incremental innovation and drive technology culture at BlackRock What We Are Looking For We seek high-caliber talent with exceptional analytical aptitude, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for solving complex challenges. Successful candidates combine strong quantitative and technical capabilities with the ability to think critically, learn rapidly, and deliver meaningful outcomes in dynamic environments. Candidates should possess: • Outstanding academic achievement and a consistent record of excellence. • Strong analytical, quantitative, and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex challenges from first principles. • Strong foundations in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or related quantitative disciplines. • Understanding of core machine-learning concepts including model training, generalization, feature representation, evaluation, optimization, and experimentation. • Ability to program in Python and familiarity with modern software-engineering practices; exposure to ML frameworks, LLMs, retrieval systems, or AI application development is advantageous. • Ability to reason about probabilistic or non-deterministic systems, design meaningful evaluations, analyze failure modes, and improve solution quality iteratively. • Curiosity and ability to develop expertise across business, technology, and product domains. • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. • A growth mindset, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning and innovation Key Responsibilities • Work on complex, high-impact engineering and business problems spanning AI-native solutions, AI-enabled applications, and foundational engineering that enables broader AI adoption. • Apply data-driven and first-principles thinking to design scalable solutions to business and technology challenges. • Design, build, evaluate and productionize platforms, systems, analytical solutions, models, and workflows that support informed decision-making and deliver measurable impact. • Apply AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI to engineering, testing, design, automation, analytics and business workflows where intelligent capabilities can materially improve outcomes. • Develop deep business and domain knowledge to identify opportunities where technology and AI can create meaningful value • Engineer AI systems beyond the model itself, integrating data pipelines, models, retrieval layers, APIs, tools and application workflows into scalable end-to-end solutions. • Analyze diverse datasets to generate actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into impactful products, processes, and technology solutions. • Contribute to foundational engineering and infrastructure that strengthens scalability, resilience, data readiness, and future AI adoption. • Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and user experiences. • Demonstrate ownership and sound judgment while communicating insights and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. • Explore emerging technologies and bring creativity and fresh thinking to evolving engineering and business challenges. Your Learning & Development You will gain: • Hands-on experience solving complex, high-impact problems across AI-native, AI-enabled and foundational engineering initiatives, while developing deep expertise in the underlying business and technology domains. • Exposure to the development of AI/ML systems from problem formulation and experimentation through evaluation, engineering and production application. • Opportunities to deepen your expertise across software engineering, AI/ML, data, platforms and emerging technologies. • Exposure to BlackRock's culture, leadership, and industry-leading platforms. • Access to structured learning, technical training, career coaching, mentorship, and professional networks. • Opportunities to collaborate with diverse, high-performing teams and solve complex challenges at global scale. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

companies.description:
At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making. Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. Capital One is looking for business analysts to drive our foray into autonomous and intelligent data products that solve the full gamut of business and analytical needs. The role will be part of an exceptional team that is drawn from elite campuses in India and abroad and focused on our mission to develop world class data products. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company and a great place to work. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives.

Job Description
At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making. Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. Capital One is looking for business analysts to drive our foray into autonomous and intelligent data products that solve the full gamut of business and analytical needs. The role will be part of an exceptional team that is drawn from elite campuses in India and abroad and focused on our mission to develop world class data products. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company and a great place to work. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives.

At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well-recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart – a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world-class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Capital One is the 6 th largest US bank in consumer deposits, among the country’s top 5 Auto Lenders and a Fortune 500 company. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will apply strategic and analytical skills to major business challenges. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives

We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well-recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart – a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world-class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Capital One is the 6 th largest US bank in consumer deposits, among the country’s top 5 Auto Lenders and a Fortune 500 company. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will apply strategic and analytical skills to major business challenges. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives

companies.description:
Cognizant® Ace Team is Cognizant's premier engineering program that brings together a select group of high-potential AI engineers to solve real-world enterprise challenges using AI-native technologies, agentic systems, and modern engineering practices. As an Ace Frontier Engineer, you will operate within a lean, high-impact Frontier pod, building and delivering AI-native solutions end-to-end across software, data, infrastructure, quality, and operations. In this role, you will design multi-agent systems, build RAG pipelines and knowledge platforms, deploy production-grade LLM applications, and integrate AI-powered workflows across business and technology environments. You will also validate AIgenerated outputs, implement guardrails, and ensure reliable AI operations in production. The program provides exposure to diverse domains, technologies, and problem spaces, enabling rapid growth across agentic AI, LLMOps, AI quality, automation and full-stack engineering. Beyond delivering working solutions, you will be responsible for driving measurable business outcomes and owning what the pod builds in production.

Cognizant® Ace Team is Cognizant's premier engineering program that brings together a select group of high-potential AI engineers to solve real-world enterprise challenges using AI-native technologies, agentic systems, and modern engineering practices. As an Ace Frontier Engineer, you will operate within a lean, high-impact Frontier pod, building and delivering AI-native solutions end-to-end across software, data, infrastructure, quality, and operations. In this role, you will design multi-agent systems, build RAG pipelines and knowledge platforms, deploy production-grade LLM applications, and integrate AI-powered workflows across business and technology environments. You will also validate AIgenerated outputs, implement guardrails, and ensure reliable AI operations in production. The program provides exposure to diverse domains, technologies, and problem spaces, enabling rapid growth across agentic AI, LLMOps, AI quality, automation and full-stack engineering. Beyond delivering working solutions, you will be responsible for driving measurable business outcomes and owning what the pod builds in production.

Job Description
Cognizant® Ace Team is Cognizant's premier engineering program that brings together a select group of high-potential AI engineers to solve real-world enterprise challenges using AI-native technologies, agentic systems, and modern engineering practices. As an Ace Frontier Engineer, you will operate within a lean, high-impact Frontier pod, building and delivering AI-native solutions end-to-end across software, data, infrastructure, quality, and operations. In this role, you will design multi-agent systems, build RAG pipelines and knowledge platforms, deploy production-grade LLM applications, and integrate AI-powered workflows across business and technology environments. You will also validate AIgenerated outputs, implement guardrails, and ensure reliable AI operations in production. The program provides exposure to diverse domains, technologies, and problem spaces, enabling rapid growth across agentic AI, LLMOps, AI quality, automation and full-stack engineering. Beyond delivering working solutions, you will be responsible for driving measurable business outcomes and owning what the pod builds in production.

Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. companies.description:
About the role: As a graduate in Deutsche Bank, you will have the opportunity to work with teams supporting the Bank's Investment Banking business globally and learn about banking from different viewpoints, which will give you a career advantage. As a graduate, your work may include: Connecting and working with global teams within the Investment Bank, and interacting with bankers, traders, and structurers in different regions across the world. Developing a strong grasp of ongoing macro events and their impact on various asset classes. Undertaking in-depth analysis of companies, sectors, and transactions, including due diligence and financial modelling of companies, industry analysis, quantitative and technical analysis, benchmarking, or supporting the execution of deals and flow trades. Developing a holistic view of the business, including the DB product suite, its operational markets, and applicable regulations. Based on this, creating marketing content related to deal pitches, new trades executed, DB capability expansion, regulatory changes, etc. Areas in which you can work: Origination & Advisory Industry Coverage (e.g., Industrials, Healthcare, TMT, etc.) Product Coverage (e.g., M&A, Ratings Advisory, Equity & Debt Capital Markets, etc.) What we look for: We recruit graduates who are intelligent and adaptable, with excellent interpersonal skills. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you will not necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. We have very comprehensive training programmes that will give you all the technical knowledge you'll need to build a career with us. To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Programme, you must: Complete your studies (all final exams and coursework) and have no outstanding requirements for graduation by July 2026. Be able to start full-time work in July 2026, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.

Job Description
About the role: As a graduate in Deutsche Bank, you will have the opportunity to work with teams supporting the Bank's Investment Banking business globally and learn about banking from different viewpoints, which will give you a career advantage. As a graduate, your work may include: Connecting and working with global teams within the Investment Bank, and interacting with bankers, traders, and structurers in different regions across the world. Developing a strong grasp of ongoing macro events and their impact on various asset classes. Undertaking in-depth analysis of companies, sectors, and transactions, including due diligence and financial modelling of companies, industry analysis, quantitative and technical analysis, benchmarking, or supporting the execution of deals and flow trades. Developing a holistic view of the business, including the DB product suite, its operational markets, and applicable regulations. Based on this, creating marketing content related to deal pitches, new trades executed, DB capability expansion, regulatory changes, etc. Areas in which you can work: Origination & Advisory Industry Coverage (e.g., Industrials, Healthcare, TMT, etc.) Product Coverage (e.g., M&A, Ratings Advisory, Equity & Debt Capital Markets, etc.) What we look for: We recruit graduates who are intelligent and adaptable, with excellent interpersonal skills. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you will not necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. We have very comprehensive training programmes that will give you all the technical knowledge you'll need to build a career with us. To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Programme, you must: Complete your studies (all final exams and coursework) and have no outstanding requirements for graduation by July 2026. Be able to start full-time work in July 2026, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.

companies.description:
The opportunity EY Parthenon is looking for a suitable member for our team in Strategy practice. The role provides an opportunity to be part of the team which assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them, analyse industry dynamics such as market size, growth, and share of leading competitors, identify the business’ unique competitive advant age and help create alignment among all business units and functions to support and en hance this positioning. Team offers clients with Business Model Reinvention, New Market Entry Opportunities and Digital Strategy and Innovation Your key responsibilities • Understand client issues and assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them • Assist team with commercial due diligence which is to analyze market dynamics including the size and growth of an industry as well as the individual target’s positioning, potential growth levers, risks, and opportunities • Assist with new strategy formulation which includes evaluating opportunities for growth including entering new geographies, offering new products and services, or serving new customer segments • Assist with solutions revolving around Digital Strategy and Innovation by assessing the clients underlying digital business models, explore avenues for new growth, both organically and inorganically, and construct the roadmap to build, grow and transform the organization for the digital world • Offering Go to Market Strategy by identifying opportunities to improve how products and services reach customers including but not limited to decisions related to route-to-market, channel selection, pricing optimization, and customer segmentation • Assisting Transaction integration services by deploying a holistic integration program that addresses topics such as people, value, control, execution and technology is imperative • Assist the project team to in help clients improve portfolio management, divestment strategy and execution FY 2025 2 • Also assist the project team in pre deal analysis and Due Diligence by synergy identification, validation, planning and delivery tracking. Also focusing on operational due diligence and IT due diligence • Responsible for a specific workstream in the project • Responsible for contributing towards knowledge sharing portals to build the practices intellectual property Skills and attributes for success • Demonstrated ability to deliver on complex assignments • Experience in delivering business strategy and diligence projects in complex environments • Strong quantitative skills for data analysis, interpretation of output, and generation of insights • Research oriented mindset • Should have an eye for detail • Ability to flex individual styles and work back with diverse teams • Strong communication skills – oral and written (in terms of making presentation) • Strong financial modelling skills and clarity of financial concepts • Desire to contribute and succeed in a fun, exciting, collegial, and challenging environment • Proficient in the English language both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment • Willingness and ability to travel To qualify for the role, you must have • Engineering graduates (from premier institute) with a good academic background Ideally, you’ll also have • Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills. • Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative. • Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client) • Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility. What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

companies.description:
At FirstClub, product isn’t just about features and roadmaps — it’s about building the foundation of trust that defines our brand. Every product decision we make either earns customer trust or erodes it. We’re hiring product folks to own either of the 3 distinct, high-impact problems that directly shape how customers experience FirstClub. You won’t be shadowing PMs or writing user stories for someone else’s roadmap. You’ll define the problem, dive deep into data, talk to customers, write the spec, work with engineering and design, ship the solution, and own the metric. Each intern will be assigned one of the three projects below. The 3 Projects: 1. Supply Chain Quality & Transparency In modern supply chains which involve multiple stages, maintaining consistent product quality across sourcing, warehousing, transportation, and delivery remains a major challenge due to fragmented processes and limited visibility across stakeholders. Customers often lack transparency into how products are handled throughout the value chain, leading to reduced trust and inconsistent experiences. The project aims to explore and design scalable tools that improve quality tracking, operational transparency, and accountability across the supply chain, enabling businesses to ensure reliable product quality and build greater customer trust. 2. Customer Retention Retention is the truest measure of whether customers love what we’re building. This project focuses on understanding why customers come back, why some don’t, and what we can do to bring them back more often. You’ll dig into cohort behavior, decode usage patterns, identify lifecycle moments that matter most (onboarding, habit formation, churn risk, win-back), and design and ship interventions that move the retention curve. Success here directly translates into long-term business health. 3. Overall App Experience The app is the primary surface where customers experience FirstClub. This project focuses on systematically identifying friction, drop-offs, and delight opportunities across the entire customer journey — product discovery, browsing, search, cart, checkout, post-order tracking, and re-engagement. You’ll combine quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative user research to ship UX and feature interventions that make the FirstClub app the highest-quality grocery experience in India. What You’ll Work On: • Framing problems clearly from first principles • Writing SQL queries and pulling data yourself — you won’t be waiting on analysts • Synthesising insights from customer interviews, support tickets, and behavioral data • Writing crisp PRDs that engineers and designers actually want to build from • Running experiments and reading results honestly • Working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, design, ops, and category teams • Owning a real metric — not just a feature shipped Why This Role Is Different: Most early product roles involve shadowing PMs and shipping nothing. At FirstClub, you’ll own a real problem from day one. This means: • You’ll be measured on outcomes, not output • You’ll have direct access to founders and senior leadership • You’ll ship to real customers, not slides • You’ll learn how product gets built in an AI-native, high-velocity startup • You’ll touch every part of the stack: data, design, engineering, operations Required Skills & Traits: We care far more about mindset than pedigree. We value people who: • Learn insanely fast • Are highly curious • Love building things • Have strong ownership mentality • Can think from first principles • Obsess over customer experience • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity • Can leverage AI tools effectively • Thrive in fast-moving environments • Want to create real-world impact Must-Have Skills: • Knowing SQL — or being willing to learn it fast — is a MUST. You will be writing queries from day one. All three projects are deeply data-driven and you cannot rely on someone else to pull numbers for you. • Strong ability to churn through messy data, identify patterns, and extract actionable insights • Comfort with spreadsheets, BI tools, and analytical thinking • Sharp written and verbal communication — you should be able to explain a problem in 3 sentences • Structured problem-solving and the discipline to break ambiguous problems into solvable pieces Bonus if you have: • Built side projects, products, communities, or businesses • Used Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT heavily for research, analysis, or prototyping • Worked on data analysis, analytics, or research projects • Run experiments or A/B tests • Built anything end-to-end independently • Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, or similar Expected Outcomes: By the end of the program, you should be able to: • Define and frame product problems clearly • Write SQL and pull data independently • Translate raw Job Description
At FirstClub, product isn’t just about features and roadmaps — it’s about building the foundation of trust that defines our brand. Every product decision we make either earns customer trust or erodes it. We’re hiring product folks to own either of the 3 distinct, high-impact problems that directly shape how customers experience FirstClub. You won’t be shadowing PMs or writing user stories for someone else’s roadmap. You’ll define the problem, dive deep into data, talk to customers, write the spec, work with engineering and design, ship the solution, and own the metric. Each intern will be assigned one of the three projects below. The 3 Projects: 1. Supply Chain Quality & Transparency In modern supply chains which involve multiple stages, maintaining consistent product quality across sourcing, warehousing, transportation, and delivery remains a major challenge due to fragmented processes and limited visibility across stakeholders. Customers often lack transparency into how products are handled throughout the value chain, leading to reduced trust and inconsistent experiences. The project aims to explore and design scalable tools that improve quality tracking, operational transparency, and accountability across the supply chain, enabling businesses to ensure reliable product quality and build greater customer trust. 2. Customer Retention Retention is the truest measure of whether customers love what we’re building. This project focuses on understanding why customers come back, why some don’t, and what we can do to bring them back more often. You’ll dig into cohort behavior, decode usage patterns, identify lifecycle moments that matter most (onboarding, habit formation, churn risk, win-back), and design and ship interventions that move the retention curve. Success here directly translates into long-term business health. 3. Overall App Experience The app is the primary surface where customers experience FirstClub. This project focuses on systematically identifying friction, drop-offs, and delight opportunities across the entire customer journey — product discovery, browsing, search, cart, checkout, post-order tracking, and re-engagement. You’ll combine quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative user research to ship UX and feature interventions that make the FirstClub app the highest-quality grocery experience in India. What You’ll Work On: • Framing problems clearly from first principles • Writing SQL queries and pulling data yourself — you won’t be waiting on analysts • Synthesising insights from customer interviews, support tickets, and behavioral data • Writing crisp PRDs that engineers and designers actually want to build from • Running experiments and reading results honestly • Working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, design, ops, and category teams • Owning a real metric — not just a feature shipped Why This Role Is Different: Most early product roles involve shadowing PMs and shipping nothing. At FirstClub, you’ll own a real problem from day one. Company Name	FirstClub

About the company	India lacks trust. There are not many brands which stand for trust. And if there are brands that stand for trust and high quality products then it’s not available at value for money pricing. India lacks a retail platform specifically built for the top 20mn India 1 households. Most platforms are built as a marketplace and not a retail store without an opinion on what they stand for, what they want to sell, who they want to sell to. Vision of FirstClub is to build a quality-first retail platform built for discerning Indian consumers with 3 pillars of trust, quality and value. While the ambition is to build a retail platform selling all categories, we have currently started with Fruits & Vegetables, Packaged grocery, Home & Kitchen categories and are currently live through quick commerce delivering to customers under 30 minutes in Bangalore and Hyderabad. Our Mission: To make high-quality products accessible and affordable to Indian consumers, while educating, empowering, and earning their trust We are not building a transaction engine We are building a curated retail experience that improves everyday life through better food and better choices The Problem We’re Solving: Indian retail has largely been built around the assumption that consumers are only price-conscious. This has resulted in mass-market products with compromised quality - “Everything stores” that optimise for assortment and discounts rather than trust Consumers are left to judge quality on their own. At the same time, there is a large and growing segment of Indian households, typically with ₹15L+ annual income, who: Care deeply about what they consume Are value-conscious rather than discount-driven Want to upgrade the quality of everyday products, not just indulge occasionally FirstClub exists to serve this overlooked middle ground. These are customers who want better, without paying luxury mark-ups or buying into marketing gimmicks. FirstClub is a curated grocery and food platform where every product is intentionally chosen, Quality is pre-verified and not assumed, customers are guided without being overwhelmed. We start with fresh and food categories such as fruits, vegetables, dairy, bakery, eggs, staples, packaged snacks and beverages. Over time, we will expand into adjacent non-food categories including kids, personal care, home and kitchen, and home care. Our initial operating model is quick commerce for metro consumers, where fast delivery helps preserve freshness. Speed, however, is a service we offer, not what defines us as a brand. What We Want to Be Known For: Across categories like fruits, vegetables, dairy, bakery, eggs, and staples, FirstClub should stand for: The freshest possible produce Finest ingredients and clean formulations Clean sourcing, preparation, and quality standards Products that create a genuine “aha” moment when used or consumed That moment when a customer thinks: “This is clearly better, and it didn’t cost me a premium.”
