Job Description
At FirstClub, product isn’t just about features and roadmaps — it’s about building the foundation of trust that defines our brand. Every product decision we make either earns customer trust or erodes it. We’re hiring product folks to own either of the 3 distinct, high-impact problems that directly shape how customers experience FirstClub. You won’t be shadowing PMs or writing user stories for someone else’s roadmap. You’ll define the problem, dive deep into data, talk to customers, write the spec, work with engineering and design, ship the solution, and own the metric. Each intern will be assigned one of the three projects below. The 3 Projects: 1. Supply Chain Quality & Transparency In modern supply chains which involve multiple stages, maintaining consistent product quality across sourcing, warehousing, transportation, and delivery remains a major challenge due to fragmented processes and limited visibility across stakeholders. Customers often lack transparency into how products are handled throughout the value chain, leading to reduced trust and inconsistent experiences. The project aims to explore and design scalable tools that improve quality tracking, operational transparency, and accountability across the supply chain, enabling businesses to ensure reliable product quality and build greater customer trust. 2. Customer Retention Retention is the truest measure of whether customers love what we’re building. This project focuses on understanding why customers come back, why some don’t, and what we can do to bring them back more often. You’ll dig into cohort behavior, decode usage patterns, identify lifecycle moments that matter most (onboarding, habit formation, churn risk, win-back), and design and ship interventions that move the retention curve. Success here directly translates into long-term business health. 3. Overall App Experience The app is the primary surface where customers experience FirstClub. This project focuses on systematically identifying friction, drop-offs, and delight opportunities across the entire customer journey — product discovery, browsing, search, cart, checkout, post-order tracking, and re-engagement. You’ll combine quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative user research to ship UX and feature interventions that make the FirstClub app the highest-quality grocery experience in India. What You’ll Work On: • Framing problems clearly from first principles • Writing SQL queries and pulling data yourself — you won’t be waiting on analysts • Synthesising insights from customer interviews, support tickets, and behavioral data • Writing crisp PRDs that engineers and designers actually want to build from • Running experiments and reading results honestly • Working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, design, ops, and category teams • Owning a real metric — not just a feature shipped Why This Role Is Different: Most early product roles involve shadowing PMs and shipping nothing. At FirstClub, you’ll own a real problem from day one. This means: • You’ll be measured on outcomes, not output • You’ll have direct access to founders and senior leadership • You’ll ship to real customers, not slides • You’ll learn how product gets built in an AI-native, high-velocity startup • You’ll touch every part of the stack: data, design, engineering, operations Required Skills & Traits: We care far more about mindset than pedigree. We value people who: • Learn insanely fast • Are highly curious • Love building things • Have strong ownership mentality • Can think from first principles • Obsess over customer experience • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity • Can leverage AI tools effectively • Thrive in fast-moving environments • Want to create real-world impact Must-Have Skills: • Knowing SQL — or being willing to learn it fast — is a MUST. You will be writing queries from day one. All three projects are deeply data-driven and you cannot rely on someone else to pull numbers for you. • Strong ability to churn through messy data, identify patterns, and extract actionable insights • Comfort with spreadsheets, BI tools, and analytical thinking • Sharp written and verbal communication — you should be able to explain a problem in 3 sentences • Structured problem-solving and the discipline to break ambiguous problems into solvable pieces Bonus if you have: • Built side projects, products, communities, or businesses • Used Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT heavily for research, analysis, or prototyping • Worked on data analysis, analytics, or research projects • Run experiments or A/B tests • Built anything end-to-end independently • Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, or similar Expected Outcomes: By the end of the program, you should be able to: • Define and frame product problems clearly • Write SQL and pull data independently • Translate raw data and customer signals into product decisions • Write PRDs that engineering and design love to work from • Ship features that move real business metrics • Run experiments end-to-end — hypothesis to readout • Think like a product owner, not a feature factory • Operate with founder-level ownership What You’ll Learn: • Product thinking from first principles • Data-driven decision making • Customer research and synthesis • Experimentation and hypothesis testing • Working cross-functionally with engineering, design, and ops • Trade-offs between speed and quality • Business-first product development • How elite startup teams actually operate Specific Courses / Learning Expectations: We strongly encourage familiarity with: Product Foundations • Product management fundamentals • Writing PRDs and product specs • User research basics • Prioritization frameworks (RICE, ICE, etc.) Data & Analytics • SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL syntax) • Cohort analysis and retention metrics • Funnel analysis and conversion math • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets • Tools like Mixpanel / Amplitude / Metabase AI Tools for Product • Using LLMs for research, synthesis, and prototyping • Prompt engineering for product workflows • Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT for everyday product work Recommended Platforms: • Lenny’s Newsletter • Mode SQL Tutorial / SQLBolt • Mixpanel / Amplitude product analytics courses • Y Combinator startup library • Writings from top product leaders (Shreyas Doshi, Marty Cagan, John Cutler) Culture at FirstClub: We are a close-knit group of builders who genuinely care about: • Product quality • Customer trust • Fast execution • Radical ownership • Open door policy • No unnecessary process theater • Just smart people building ambitious things together Who Should NOT Apply: This role may not be a fit if: • You prefer heavily structured environments • You wait for detailed instructions • You dislike fast iteration cycles • You are uncomfortable with ownership • You think product is about meetings and frameworks, not metrics • You want to write strategy decks without shipping anything • You’re allergic to SQL and getting your hands dirty in data Who Will Thrive Here: You’ll love FirstClub if: • You’ve ever built something just for fun • You obsess over how products make you feel • You enjoy solving hard, messy, ambiguous problems • You want to work at startup speed • You believe great products come from great taste backed by great data • You want to help build the future instead of watching it happen

companies.description:
The AI Solutions Org is a new, high-velocity engineering unit at Flipkart with a singular mission: to accelerate AI adoption across the entire company. Will operate as a "SWAT team" for AI - building end-to-end solutions for business functions that lack engineering bandwidth, while also partnering with the core Data Science team to optimize and scale state-of-the-art models (FK LLMs, Open Source, Commercial). This is not a traditional software engineering role. We believe the future of coding is AI-assisted. You are expected to be an AI-Native Engineer: ● You don't just write code; you orchestrate it. You leverage tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and LLMs to write code, generate test cases, debug, and perform RCAs at 10x speed. ● You are Full-Stack + AI. You are comfortable setting up a backend API, building a quick UI, and engineering a complex RAG pipeline in the same sprint. You'll be responsible for: 1. End-to-End AI Feature Development: Write clean, efficient code using AI coding assistants to build, test, and own full AI features from concept to release. 2. LLM Integration & RAG Pipelines: Implement LLM API integrations, craft effective prompts, construct E2E RAG architecture using Vector DBs and embeddings, analyze commercial vs. open-source models for cost and performance. 3. Architecture, Deployment & Performance: Design mid-sized AI application architectures, deploy services via Docker/K8s or internal platforms, optimize inference latency, and assist Data Science teams with basic fine-tuning. 4. AI Native Operations & Engineering Mentorship: Use AI tools for automated unit testing, documentation, and production root cause analysis.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. We believe the future of coding is AI-assisted. You are expected to be an AI-Native Engineer: ● You don't just write code; you orchestrate it. You leverage tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and LLMs to write code, generate test cases, debug, and perform RCAs at 10x speed. ● You are Full-Stack + AI. You are comfortable setting up a backend API, building a quick UI, and engineering a complex RAG pipeline in the same sprint. You'll be responsible for: 1. End-to-End AI Feature Development: Write clean, efficient code using AI coding assistants to build, test, and own full AI features from concept to release. 2. LLM Integration & RAG Pipelines: Implement LLM API integrations, craft effective prompts, construct E2E RAG architecture using Vector DBs and embeddings, analyze commercial vs. open-source models for cost and performance. 3. Architecture, Deployment & Performance: Design mid-sized AI application architectures, deploy services via Docker/K8s or internal platforms, optimize inference latency, and assist Data Science teams with basic fine-tuning. 4. AI Native Operations & Engineering Mentorship: Use AI tools for automated unit testing, documentation, and production root cause analysis.

companies.description:
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Bangalore, India Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

PLACEMENT	Quantitative Strategist	5000000 INR			0.0

Job Description
As a Quantitative Strategists you will be working in one of the business-aligned teams. You will work on a variety of workstreams including pricing and risk models for complex financial products, alpha generating strategies, portfolio allocation problems and models for prediction, trading automation, data analysis. Candidates would be required to apply their mathematical and problem-solving skills to a real-world business problem.As a member of our team, you will: • partner globally across multiple divisions and engineering teams to create quantitative modelingbased solutions. • be able to innovate and incubate new ideas. • learn from experts in quantitative finance. • have an opportunity to work on a broad range of problems, across multiple revenue generating as well as control divisions.

As a Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, multi-cloud platforms, edge compute, and real-time streaming architectures. You won’t just maintain pipelines; you will provision dedicated enterprise-grade cloud environments, architect multi-cloud topologies, orchestrate edge fleets, integrate IP camera networks, and build the mission-critical foundation powering our global scale. If you thrive on solving deep technical challenges across the entire stack, from embedded networking, ONVIF camera discovery, and Linux daemons up to multi-cluster Kubernetes control planes, this is where your impact begins on Day 1.

Job Description
We are hiring our first Associate Product Manager to work directly with Hakimo's founding product manager. Our product sits where computer vision, human operators and real-world security meet, so every decision has to work for three groups at once: the customers paying for protection, the operators responding to alerts, and the AI models generating them. You will start by owning real problems from week one: investigating incidents, turning customer and operator feedback into specs, and shipping features with our engineering and AI teams. As you grow, you will take ownership of a product area end to end.

PLACEMENT	Associate Product Manager	2000000 INR
Job Description
We are hiring our first Associate Product Manager to work directly with Hakimo's founding product manager. Our product sits where computer vision, human operators and real-world security meet, so every decision has to work for three groups at once: the customers paying for protection, the operators responding to alerts, and the AI models generating them. You will start by owning real problems from week one: investigating incidents, turning customer and operator feedback into specs, and shipping features with our engineering and AI teams. As you grow, you will take ownership of a product area end to end.

Hakimo is seeking a Founder's Office Analyst to work with Founder's Office (IIT, IIM and McKinsey alumnus). This role sits at the high-velocity intersection of strategy, data analytics, go-to-market (GTM) execution, and cross-functional operations. As an Analyst, you will tackle ambiguous, high-priority business problems across the company. You will move fluidly between quantitative research, revenue pipeline analysis, cross-team alignment, and hands-on operational work handling multiple critical threads with direct mentorship and significant ownership from day one. Job Description
The cornerstone of Hakimo's platform is computer vision, where Deep Learning, Multimodal AI and Visual generative models power the core of our AI capabilities. We are looking for talented Applied ML(Machine Learning) Engineers to join us directly from campus and help build, optimize, and scale the vision intelligence driving our products. In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and real-world deployment. You will design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art vision models, ranging from core object detection and tracking to multi-modal and vision language models, handling millions of real-time video streams in production.

The cornerstone of Hakimo's platform is computer vision, where Deep Learning, Multimodal AI and Visual generative models power the core of our AI capabilities. companies.description:
We are looking for Full-Stack AI Engineers to design, build and ship AI-powered products across our healthcare data platform and build and test features and pipelines with guidance. You will work across machine learning and GenAI, backend services, frontend applications, data engineering and DevOps, taking problems from raw healthcare data all the way to reliable production systems and the interfaces our customers use every day. Technologies you'll work with- Languages: Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, Golang. Rust Backend: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Spring Boot, Node.js, Celery Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Material UI (including MUI X DataGrid), Tailwind CSS, Vite, Highcharts AI/ML: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and Amazon Bedrock models; small and open-source models (for example Llama, Mistral, Qwen) served with vLLM or Ollama; LangChain/LangGraph; PyTorch, Hugging Face, scikit-learn, XGBoost; Ray; Langfuse for LLM tracing and cost tracking Data: Spark/PySpark on AWS EMR, Airflow, AWS Lambda and Step Functions; PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Redshift, DuckDB, Redis; OpenSearch; SQS and Kafka Cloud: AWS (primary), with Azure for selected deployments

That momentum is rooted in a tech-first product engine: seven proprietary solutions that combine agentic AI, machine learning, domain-trained LLMs, and generative AI to clean up the industry’s hardest data problems—from directory errors and ghost networks to roster mismatches, contract complexity, and unstructured clinical data. companies.description:
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

Job Description
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

Job Description
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

companies.description:
IDFC FIRST Bank's core philosophy follows a customer centric promise Always You First. The bank aspires to provide high quality financial solutions for emerging India, while keeping customer at the core. The Purpose The Associate Data Scientist-AI supports the design, development, and deployment of Generative AI solutions that enhance business processes, customer experience, and decision-making. The role focuses on building, fine-tuning, and evaluating large language models (LLMs) and other generative models, working closely with senior data scientists, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to translate use cases into scalable AI solutions. Roles & Responsibilities Generative AI Development: • Assist in developing, fine-tuning, and evaluating Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models, embedding models) for business use cases such as text generation, summarization, classification, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). • Implement prompt engineering, prompt optimization, and guardrails to improve model performance, safety, and reliability. • Support experimentation with open-source and commercial GenAI models and frameworks. Data Preparation & Modeling • Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured data (text, documents, logs, etc.) to support GenAI pipelines. • Create and maintain feature sets, embeddings, and vector databases for downstream applications. • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns and insights that inform model design. Model Evaluation & Optimization • Define and execute evaluation strategies using quantitative metrics and qualitative assessments (e.g., relevance, accuracy, hallucination rate). • Analyze model outputs, identify failure modes, and recommend improvements. • Support A/B testing and continuous monitoring of deployed GenAI solutions. Deployment & Collaboration • Assist in deploying GenAI solutions into production environments in collaboration with ML engineers and platform teams. • Work with product managers, business analysts, and domain experts to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. • Document models, experiments, and best practices for reproducibility and knowledge sharing. Governance & Best Practices • Adhere to responsible AI, data privacy, and security guidelines. • Support compliance with internal AI governance, ethical AI standards, and regulatory requirements. • Stay up to date with emerging GenAI techniques, tools, and industry trends Skills: • You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them) • You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet) • You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding! • You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business! • You know when to look things up on the internet!

Deployment & Collaboration • Assist in deploying GenAI solutions into production environments in collaboration with ML engineers and platform teams. • Work with product managers, business analysts, and domain experts to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. • Document models, experiments, and best practices for reproducibility and knowledge sharing. Governance & Best Practices • Adhere to responsible AI, data privacy, and security guidelines. • Support compliance with internal AI governance, ethical AI standards, and regulatory requirements. • Stay up to date with emerging GenAI techniques, tools, and industry trends Skills: • You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them) • You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet) • You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding! • You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business! • You know when to look things up on the internet!

Job Description
IDFC FIRST Bank's core philosophy follows a customer centric promise Always You First. The bank aspires to provide high quality financial solutions for emerging India, while keeping customer at the core. About your future dream team: Our team is pivotal for delivering the vision – Always You First. This team acts as a center of excellence to provide accurate and timely insights and data driven solutions to drive personalized and innovative product offerings to our customers. At IDFC First bank, we know that not everyone can bring all the skills & experiences to the table, therefore, we are more focused on people bringing a growth mindset to their approach to work. Learning on the job is the way we work, so don’t worry if don’t have all! We work closely with all business units (product, sales), functional stakeholders (e.g. credit, operations, Journey Excellence), technology teams (IT team and vendors) and external partners (e.g. DSAs, agencies) to create and deliver competitive advantage and quantifiable impact on the Bank’s performance. Also, to add, we not only work with traditional data environment of relational databases, SQL/SAS but also in AWS using PySpark, Sagemaker and other Auto – ML tools like Altair. The Purpose The Data Analyst role –  Identifies business needs  Builds advanced analytical ML & DL tools  Develop test strategies  Supports Senior Analysts & Lead Analyst in delivering business outcome Areas that play to your strengths All the responsibilities we’ll trust you with –  Identify and scope business requirements and priorities through rigorous information gathering and analysis as well as clarification of the solutions, initiatives and programs to enable effective delivery.  Design analytics techniques to meet current and future business needs.  Robust understanding of data and fields required or analysis.  Understanding of analytical framework and map it with data available  Develop a test strategy and systematic test procedures to verify and ensure that solution meets its design specifications  Develop, select and apply algorithms and advanced computational methods to enable systems to learn, improve, adapt and produce desired outcomes or tasks.  Displays the ability to approach existing situations and problems in a new manner and creates innovative solutions  Challenges the status quo to bring about continuous improvement in performance, drives changes that would have a positive impact on the organization  Works to achieve goals and objectives and shows a strong drive to follow through and complete what was started.  Recognizes the complex interrelationships among business activities and understands the "big picture" of how decisions impact the overall business, outcomes and processes  Has an innate orientation to be aware of how one contributes to the larger vision of the Bank Things we’ll like about you!  You love problem solving, you have excellent communication skills and you are action oriented (you like doing stuff, not just thinking or talking about them)  You can work with unstructured problem statements (like estimating how many square feet of pizza is consumed in India in a day without looking it up on the internet)  You get excited at the prospect of working with large volumes of data and enjoy coding!  You are open to learning continuously – irrespective of whether it is a new technology, a new algorithm or a new business!  You know when to look things up on the internet!

Scale: IDFC FIRST Bank is one of India’s fast-growing private banks, building its UI, UX, and tech stack like a fintech. As of June 30, 2026, the Bank has a customer business of Rs. 6,04,776 crore including deposits and loans, with YoY growth of around 20%. 3. Scope: We are a universal Bank offering complete range of services, including Retail, MSME, Rural, Startups, Corporate Banking, Cash Management, Credit Cards, Wealth Management, Deposits, Government Banking, Working Capital, Trade Finance, and Treasury solutions. 4. Ethical Banking: We are committed to doing right even when customers are not watching. We have simplified descriptions, calculations, and legal jargon to avoid confusing customers. 5. Digital Banking: The Bank's modern technology stack delivers high-quality services across all channels like mobile, branch, internet banking, call centers and relationship managers. Built on cloud-native, API-led, microservices architecture, supported with data, analytics, AI, and fine aesthetics, we strive to deliver fintech-grade experiences on banking platform. 6. Social Good: We have served over 40 million customers in inclusive banking, including 3.6 million women entrepreneurs, 7.5 million lifestyle improvement loans, 2 million livelihood loans, 300,000+ SMEs, 2.7 lakh water and sanitation loans, and 2.5 lakh electric vehicles. Our ESG credentials are strong and steadily improving. 7. Customer Friendly Banking: We make banking easy by having a customer first approach. We have waived fees on 36 essential savings account services which are commonly charged in the market, the first and only bank in India to do so. We create “pull” products that customers actively seek out. 8. Governance: We adhere to regulatory guidelines in letter and spirit and actively work with regulators to make things better. We take pride in maintaining highest levels of corporate governance. 9. Shareholders: We are building a well-diversified universal banking portfolio designed to deliver consistent ROE of 16%+. 10. Employees: IDFC FIRST Bank is designed to be a happy place to work, with cutting-edge roles, meaningful growth opportunities, and a culture of meritocracy. Compensation is healthy, efforts are recognized, and employees experience the pride and excitement of creating a world-class Bank in India.

Our leaders are quoted by leading global publications such as Forbes, CIO magazine, VentureBeat, Fox Business, Information Week, etc. This is a front-end opportunity which will allow you to use Analytics & Machine Learning to address some of the most exciting problems in fintech, banking & digital sectors while directly liaising with CEOs, CMOs, CROs, and Heads of P&L. You will have unparalleled, complete ownership of your projects. Why Indus? • Fast moving organization for someone who is keen to climb an exponential growth trajectory • Exposure to multi-faceted projects, helping you gain deep insights into various businesses • A rigorous on-the-job training regimen that trains you in critical analytical and programming skills (Python, SQL, R, Tableau) from the ground-up, with no prerequisites • A bright, driven, & extremely talented team of colleagues • Cutting-edge work wherein data science meets Fintech and Insurtech with a presence across multiple countries • A strong ethic of employee centricity that invests heavily in holistic professional development of every individual If you like the overlap of business, math, and technology, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, this role is tailor-made for you! More Details: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLvmkiysf10Hg3tXNw8Sh3HrISEobBkt4a&feature=shared Roles and Responsibilities 1. Drive analytics projects for our clients a. Translate broad business problems into clear, coherent frameworks b. Deploy a complex toolkit a of problem-solving approaches, participate in brainstorming sessions with the team c. Manipulate, merge, and create hygienic datasets from a variety of sources; be the subject-matter expert on client data and trends d. Use advanced statistical techniques (regression, machine learning) to create predictive algorithms, economic valuation models, perform impact sizing, stress testing. Evaluate their performance and finetune them to suit business needs e. Combine insights from data and deep business understanding to create business cases and sharing recommendations with CXOs 2. Client and Project Management a. Work directly with client maps to understand the business context and data trends b. Partner with them to address data issues and ensure consistency between data trends and actual business performance c. Present findings, updates, and recommendations to clients on a periodic basis d. Ensure smooth delivery of the project, provide periodic updates to Indus leadership & to clients, highlight roadblocks, etc. 3. Other Activities a. Be involved in hiring activities of Indus b. Lead internal workstreams, such as internal R&D projects, business development assistance, lead new joining training sessions, etc. Sample Business Problems Addressed We develop sophisticated predictive models & machine learning algorithms for our clients, and act as their extended teams for ongoing analytical needs. Our focus is the financial services sector, where we add value in marketing analytics, customer management analytics (churn, lifetime value modelling, next-best-offer, etc), and analytics in credit risk, pricing collections & fraud areas. 1. Reducing cost of operating airlines by creating accurate and optimized schedules 2. Reducing losses for lending firms by creating machine learning-based models to identify high risk borrowers 3. Increasing marketing effectiveness by targeting customers likely to use the credit card being offered Key Expectations 1. Professional Qualifications Eligible courses: a. B. Tech, M. Tech and Dual Degree courses 2. Competencies a. A curious person with a drive to solve business problems and being solution oriented b. Someone with an entrepreneurial mindset & humility c. companies.description:
Who We Are Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity What’s In It For U • Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative • Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. • Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. • More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. • Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. • Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. • Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. • Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. • Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. • Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. About the role We are looking for a curious, hands-on Software Engineer who is excited to build reliable applications across the full stack and explore practical applications of artificial intelligence. This role is designed for a recent graduate who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into useful software. What you’ll do Build, test, and maintain user-facing features and backend services. Develop clean, responsive interfaces and well-structured APIs. Work with databases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to application performance and reliability. Explore and integrate AI capabilities—such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or intelligent automation—where they solve real user problems. Write readable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, testing, and technical discussions. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teammates to deliver features from concept through release. Learn the team’s tools and engineering practices and contribute ideas for continuous improvement. What we’re looking for A 2026 graduate of with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and debugging. Hands-on experience building projects across the frontend and backend through coursework, internships, open-source work, or personal projects. Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (such as React, Angular, or Vue) and one backend language or framework (such as Java/Spring, Python, Node.js, or .NET). Working knowledge of REST APIs, relational or NoSQL databases, Git, and software testing fundamentals. Genuine interest in AI/ML and experience—or a strong willingness to learn—using AI APIs, LLMs, prompt design, embeddings, or related tools. Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to learn from feedback. Nice to have Internship, capstone, or personal project experience shipping a full-stack application. Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, or application monitoring. Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs, handling failure cases, and considering privacy, security, and reliability in AI-enabled features. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or project write-up that demonstrates how you approach software problems.

Job Description
Who We Are Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed. We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise. While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer. Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity What’s In It For U • Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative • Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it. • Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you. • More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent. • Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year. • Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average. • Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally. • Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole. • Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses. • Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus. About the role We are looking for a curious, hands-on Software Engineer who is excited to build reliable applications across the full stack and explore practical applications of artificial intelligence. This role is designed for a recent graduate who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into useful software. What you’ll do Build, test, and maintain user-facing features and backend services. Develop clean, responsive interfaces and well-structured APIs. Work with databases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to application performance and reliability. Explore and integrate AI capabilities—such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or intelligent automation—where they solve real user problems. Write readable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, testing, and technical discussions. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering teammates to deliver features from concept through release. Learn the team’s tools and engineering practices and contribute ideas for continuous improvement. What we’re looking for A 2026 graduate of with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and debugging. Hands-on experience building projects across the frontend and backend through coursework, internships, open-source work, or personal projects. Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (such as React, Angular, or Vue) and one backend language or framework (such as Java/Spring, Python, Node.js, or .NET). Working knowledge of REST APIs, relational or NoSQL databases, Git, and software testing fundamentals. Genuine interest in AI/ML and experience—or a strong willingness to learn—using AI APIs, LLMs, prompt design, embeddings, or related tools. Clear communication, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to learn from feedback. Nice to have Internship, capstone, or personal project experience shipping a full-stack application. Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, or application monitoring. Experience evaluating AI-generated outputs, handling failure cases, and considering privacy, security, and reliability in AI-enabled features. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or project write-up that demonstrates how you approach software problems.

companies.description:
In this role, you will be one of the resources in our extended team working out of Mumbai, with an opportunity to be involved in the entire spectrum of activities in a VC fund, as well as work on portfolio-specific business development opportunities. You will be closely involved with portfolio company activities on behalf of the Fund, including business development activities, tracking and monitoring and strategy be reviewing and preparing business plans, performing valuation analysis, assist in providing primary and secondary sources of research, conducting due diligence, preparing investing memos, develop investment theses and deal pipeline through primary and secondary research (including but not limited to industry research, company research, macro research, etc.) meet and source excellent investment ideas (business development), be hands-on in existing deals run by senior deal team members, assist with fund-raising initiatives and investor relations, crucially, you will understand the nuances of early-stage investing.

companies.description:
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

companies.description:
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.
