Job Description
Embedded Software: Build the firmware that powers next-gen wearables using ultra-low-energy Wi-R wireless technology. �� On‑site – Bengaluru, India | Competitive salary + bonus + early equity ��About Ixana Ixana is a Purdue University spinoff pioneering brain-inspired wearable computing. We've developed Wi-R, a patented communication tech that's 100x more energy-efficient than Bluetooth or WiFi. Join our 60-person team building the next era of real-time, AI-powered human-computer interaction. �� The Wi-R Revolution Wi-R is our patented non-radiative near-field communication technology that creates secure "wire-like wireless" experiences through small E-field bubbles around your body. This breakthrough enables unprecedented energy efficiency at sub-0.1 nanojoules per bit, making long-term wearable and implantable devices finally practical. See Wi-R in action: Visit ixana.ai for demos of high-speed data streaming through skin contact: https://vimeo.com/ixana/pairing-contact-transfer What You’ll Do Write bare-metal C/C++ firmware to interface MCUs with sensors and Wi-R chips. Lead embedded software development for Wi-R reference devices like smartglasses, smartwatches, earbuds, EEG/EMG nodes, and more. Build, test, and debug low level embedded code on custom hardware platforms. Integrate and optimize communication protocols (I2C, SPI, BLE) for wearable use cases. Work closely with hardware and system engineers to iterate on design and bring-up. Help shape and contribute to the new Wi-R embedded software standard. What We're Looking For One of the following must be true: experience writing embedded code for wearable or silicon chip bring-up. Strong experience with MCU firmware development. Low-level coding ability (bare-metal, register-level) and ow-power optimization skills. Familiarity with interfaces like I2C, SPI, BLE, and hands-on debugging. Preferred Qualifications Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and embedded debugging tools. Familiarity with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB. Exposure to personal embedded projects or hardware hacking. PCB design or firmware–hardware co-design experience. Experience working with toolchains, makefiles, and custom build environments. �� Compensation & Benefits • Base salary: Competitive and based on experience • Cash bonus + meaningful early‑stage equity • Relocation bonus, partner job‑search help • Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, inventor cash awards �� Why Join Us Work on deep tech that matters Collaborate with world-class experts and industry leaders Own your work end-to-end and see real impact Enjoy a culture of speed, rigor, and respect Competitive salary, equity, and global exposure �� Location On-site — Bengaluru, India (Brookefield Mall area). Multiple openings available across experience levels — from fresh graduates to 10+ years of industry experience. ��Application Requirements Resume (Optional) Personal embedded projects or GitHub links Short write-up on an embedded system you've built or contributed to Ready to re‑wire the future of human-computer interaction? Apply via our careers page. In your note, tell us how you envision using Wi‑R to transform everyday experiences—across healthcare, industry, or consumer tech. Ixana is an equal opportunity employer committed to advancing human-computer interfaces through innovative low-power electronics innovation. Keywords: Embedded Systems, Wearables, C/C++, MCU Firmware, Bare Metal, Low-Power Design, Wi-R, Startup, Equity, I2C, SPI, BLE, Embedded Debugging

companies.description:
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company, backed by top-tier investors, that is solving India's massive property dispute problem by offering the nation's fastest and most comprehensive property title search engine. Our platform retrieves critical legal documents in seconds, effectively building the operating system for property ownership in India and transforming a $200 billion industry currently responsible for two-thirds of all court cases. Landeed is scaling rapidly, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. The role of an early-stage Software Engineer involves working directly with the founding team to design scalable backend systems, build AI/ML solutions for data extraction and analytics, and create intuitive frontends, requiring strong skills in languages like Python and JavaScript. This is a high-impact, wealth-building opportunity to join the first 50 employees of a fast-growing startup, gain expertise in proptech and legal tech, and directly influence product strategy that impacts millions of Indian families. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

companies.description:
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company building India's real estate operating system, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. Frontier labs post-train on the open internet; we post-train on data the internet has never seen: handwritten deeds in six languages, regional-dialect voice conversations, survey maps and satellite imagery, and decades of skewed scans. Terra is our multi-agent system where models converse with users in voice and text, read documents and site photos, reason over video and GIS data, and make judgment calls that lenders and families act on. As an AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training) you will adapt open-weight language, vision-language and speech models to Terra, end to end from data curation through training, evals and deployment: SFT and preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-class methods), agentic behaviour tuning (tool use, multi-step reasoning, code-switching across Indian languages), provenance-grounded structured outputs, speech adaptation for Indian languages, GIS and visual grounding, training data pipelines, and evaluation suites that gate releases. We look for strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, solid Python and PyTorch, familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem, and projects, research or internships where the candidate personally fine-tuned or trained a model. This is hands-on training work in production with a small, senior team, working directly with the founders. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

Job Profile

Form Type	Designation	Cost to Company per year	Bond / Service Contract	Additional Criteria	CGPA Cut-off
PLACEMENT	AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training)	16000000 INR			0.0

Job Description
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company building India's real estate operating system, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. Frontier labs post-train on the open internet; we post-train on data the internet has never seen: handwritten deeds in six languages, regional-dialect voice conversations, survey maps and satellite imagery, and decades of skewed scans. Terra is our multi-agent system where models converse with users in voice and text, read documents and site photos, reason over video and GIS data, and make judgment calls that lenders and families act on. As an AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training) you will adapt open-weight language, vision-language and speech models to Terra, end to end from data curation through training, evals and deployment: SFT and preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-class methods), agentic behaviour tuning (tool use, multi-step reasoning, code-switching across Indian languages), provenance-grounded structured outputs, speech adaptation for Indian languages, GIS and visual grounding, training data pipelines, and evaluation suites that gate releases. We look for strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, solid Python and PyTorch, familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem, and projects, research or internships where the candidate personally fine-tuned or trained a model. This is hands-on training work in production with a small, senior team, working directly with the founders. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

Job Profile
Form Type	Designation	Cost to Company per year
PLACEMENT	AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training)	16000000 INR
Job Description
Landeed is a Y Combinator (S22) alumni company building India's real estate operating system, with over 10 million users across 24+ Indian states. Frontier labs post-train on the open internet; we post-train on data the internet has never seen: handwritten deeds in six languages, regional-dialect voice conversations, survey maps and satellite imagery, and decades of skewed scans. Terra is our multi-agent system where models converse with users in voice and text, read documents and site photos, reason over video and GIS data, and make judgment calls that lenders and families act on. As an AI/ML Engineer (Post-Training) you will adapt open-weight language, vision-language and speech models to Terra, end to end from data curation through training, evals and deployment: SFT and preference optimization (DPO/GRPO-class methods), agentic behaviour tuning (tool use, multi-step reasoning, code-switching across Indian languages), provenance-grounded structured outputs, speech adaptation for Indian languages, GIS and visual grounding, training data pipelines, and evaluation suites that gate releases. We look for strong ML and deep learning fundamentals, solid Python and PyTorch, familiarity with the Hugging Face ecosystem, and projects, research or internships where the candidate personally fine-tuned or trained a model. This is hands-on training work in production with a small, senior team, working directly with the founders. This position will be open only to students who meet the eligibility criteria listed below: All degrees in the following departments: Artificial Intelligence, Centre for Computational and Data Sciences, Centre for Interdisciplinary and Convergent Technologies, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, G.S Sanyal School of Telecommunication, Mathematics. The eligibility will extend to all students that have a Minor in Computer Science and to all students having a Dual Degree Specialization in Financial Engineering or Dual Degree in Artificial Intelligence.

companies.description:
Full-Time | Core Team | Bengaluru LAT Aerospace | Civil, Defence & GTE At LAT Aerospace, we're solving critical aerospace problems in India, for the world, across three programs: regional mobility through short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft, aircraft and drone propulsion through indigenous gas turbine engines, and securing our borders with cutting-edge autonomy and tech aiding our armed forces. We're hiring graduate engineers who want to own a subsystem, not shadow one - pick a problem below and work on it directly inside one of our programs. What you'll work on Aerodynamics - CFD and low-fidelity simulations of blown wing aerodynamics, and flight dynamic models for advanced wing configurations to support STOL constraints GNC - Low-speed control of our aircraft using the distributed propulsion architecture; software and hardware-in-loop simulations to validate control logic Structures - Design, FEA, and testing loops for primary and secondary aircraft structures; integrating powertrain, stacked electric ducted fans, and other components into a reliable airframe Powertrain - Power electronics, controls, thermals, and integration of our hybrid-electric powertrain Gas Turbine Engine - Compressor, combustion chamber, turbines, materials, manufacturing, and FADEC control Autonomy and Defence - CUAS radar, interceptor drones, navigation computers, GNSS-denied operation What we're looking for High action bias - a "getting things done" attitude and confidence tackling varied, tough technical challenges Real depth in at least one of: aerodynamics, structures, GNC, powertrain, turbomachinery, autonomy, electronics. Depth in one beats a shallow pass over all six Evidence that you build things - FSAE, Aero Design, rocketry, hyperloop, UAV or robotics teams, published work, a strong BTP, or a serious personal build. What you did matters more than the team's ranking Comfort with ambiguity - incomplete requirements, changing designs, and decisions made with imperfect data should sound interesting, not alarming Why LAT? Core team opportunity at a high-conviction deep-tech startup Real aircraft, real flying hardware, real impact Ownership from day one - your own analyses, your own components, one desk away from the people making the biggest calls Build the future of sustainable aviation in a secure India

About the company	Imagine a world where flying is as easy as taking a bus – where air travel isn't reserved for major cities, but reaches everyone, everywhere. No congested hubs, no security lines, no hours lost in transit. Just seamless, affordable, on-demand flights connecting thousands of destinations the world has overlooked for too long. We're building the future of mass aviation: a network of high-frequency, low-cost, 8-seater STOL (short take-off and landing) aircraft that make every city, town, and community accessible. Our aircraft take off and land from compact "air-stops" no bigger than a parking lot – no baggage belts, no bottlenecks, none of the expensive airport infrastructure that regional travel was never meant to need. But easy flight is the outcome of hard engineering – and that engineering doesn't stop at the airframe. The engine that powers it, the autonomy that flies it, the systems that defend it are all the same problem. So we're building three capabilities India should own itself: Civil: an 8-seater hybrid-electric STOL aircraft, designed ground-up for efficiency and built for affordability. Gas Turbine Engines: world-class gas turbine engines developed in-house, laying the foundations of a true aerospace ecosystem. Defence: sovereign autonomy and defence systems that perceive, decide, and act in the real world. Aerodynamics from first principles. Propulsion built in-house. Autonomy from day one. This isn't the supersonic fantasy you've been sold. It's the aviation our communities actually need.

companies.description:
The role provides a very good mix of technical and business exposure to the exciting world of online advertising. As a part of the Product Management Team, you will work with world class engineering, data sciences, usability, business development, design and marketing teams to develop and evangelize one or more ground- breaking, globally distributed, large scale products. ● Product Analysts work with product managers to implement new products/features, as well as utilize data to suggest improvements. ● Utilize product data to research market trends. ● Create reports about the performance of a given product/feature and suggest possible improvements. ● Must liaise with numerous stakeholders from different business teams. ● Study the competition to see what is already on the market, and what upgrades can be introduced to create a better or more useful product. ● Monitor the products’ performance across different markets and prepare detailed reports.

About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Compensation & Perks Total CTC: ₹36 LPA Fixed Pay: ₹15.30 L Variable: ₹2.7 L Joining Bonus (at the time of joining): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 1): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 2): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 3): ₹4 L Retention Bonus (end of year 4): ₹5 L Perks You'll Love: 🧠 Exposure to leaders & steep learning curve ✨ Impact from Day 1 in one of India's fastest-growing startups 🏆 Performance-based growth & ownership 🍕 Food, fun, and vibrant office spaces Why Meesho? Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

Job Description
About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Compensation & Perks Total CTC: ₹36 LPA Fixed Pay: ₹15.30 L Variable: ₹2.7 L Joining Bonus (at the time of joining): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 1): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 2): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 3): ₹4 L Retention Bonus (end of year 4): ₹5 L Perks You'll Love: 🧠 Exposure to leaders & steep learning curve ✨ Impact from Day 1 in one of India's fastest-growing startups 🏆 Performance-based growth & ownership 🍕 Food, fun, and vibrant office spaces Why Meesho? Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

About the company	Moneyview is in the online/instant personal loan space, catering to the underserved segments, providing loans of upto 10L through a completely digital platform. Our unique IP assesses creditworthiness using multiple data sources and does not rely only on the bureau score, thus offering better approval rates and loan amounts. Our easy-to-use App makes the documentation process simple, providing the loan within a few minutes! Apart from loans, the app will soon provide Savings A/c, Credit Score Check and Investment products under the Moneyview super app umbrella. Moneyview is around 10yrs old; Series E funded by marquee investors like Accel, Tiger Global, Accel, and Ribbit Capital, and is currently valued at $900 millions. We provide loans in partnership with top NBFCs and Banks. Moneyview is also a founding member of DLAI- Digital lenders association of India- a widely recognised body for Fintech players in India.

About the company	Moneyview is in the online/instant personal loan space, catering to the underserved segments, providing loans of upto 10L through a completely digital platform. Our unique IP assesses creditworthiness using multiple data sources and does not rely only on the bureau score, thus offering better approval rates and loan amounts. Our easy-to-use App makes the documentation process simple, providing the loan within a few minutes! Apart from loans, the app will soon provide Savings A/c, Credit Score Check and Investment products under the Moneyview super app umbrella. Moneyview is around 10yrs old; Series E funded by marquee investors like Accel, Tiger Global, Accel, and Ribbit Capital, and is currently valued at $900 millions. We provide loans in partnership with top NBFCs and Banks. Moneyview is also a founding member of DLAI- Digital lenders association of India- a widely recognised body for Fintech players in India.

Associate Manager - AI Strategy & Operations (AISO) Location: Bangalore About the Team Navi’s GenAI team is transforming how AI powers financial services in India. We are embedding advanced AI that directly impacts millions of users across Lending, Payments, Insurance, and Investments. As a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers, and product leaders, we work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real business problems—shipping fast, learning constantly, and scaling what works. About the Role The Associate Manager - AISO (AI Strategy & Operations) role is a position focused on executing prompt engineering, testing, and debugging tasks for AI powered applications. The role supports the development and maintenance of AI chatbots and automation use cases under guidance from senior team members. Must Haves ● Strong written and verbal communication skills in English ● High attention to detail and quality ● Logical reasoning and structured thinking ● Ability to analyze text outputs and identify inconsistencies or logical gaps ● Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solution-oriented mindset ● Ability to learn new tools, workflows, and AI concepts quickly ● Comfort working in ambiguous and iterative environments ● Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Preferred backgrounds: Economics, English, Psychology, Marketing, Social Sciences) Preferred Skills ● Exposure to AI tools, chatbots, or LLM-based platforms ● Strong comprehension and critical analysis skills ● Ability to break down complex problems into structured evaluation scenarios ● Familiarity with structured documentation and reporting What You’ll Do ● Develop and iterate prompts for AI based applications. ● Test AI outputs across multiple scenarios, edge cases, and user journeys ● Identify prompt-level failures, hallucinations, and inconsistent behavior ● Analyze interaction logs and transcripts to improve bot accuracy ● Execute bulk testing using internal tools ● Document findings, improvements, and version updates clearly ● Collaborate with AI Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineers to implement improvements What We Expect From You ● High ownership and a proactive approach to solving problems ● Strong written clarity and ability to reason through ambiguity ● Comfort with fast-changing environments and an agile mindset ● Curiosity about AI systems and how large language models behave ● Structured thinking under pressure ● A mindset of continuous improvement and learning About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! To know more about us, our work, people, culture, values etc., check out navi.com/careers. Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/careers/values-at-navi to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

Job Description
Associate Manager - AI Strategy & Operations (AISO) Location: Bangalore About the Team Navi’s GenAI team is transforming how AI powers financial services in India. We are embedding advanced AI that directly impacts millions of users across Lending, Payments, Insurance, and Investments. As a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers, and product leaders, we work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real business problems—shipping fast, learning constantly, and scaling what works. About the Role The Associate Manager - AISO (AI Strategy & Operations) role is a position focused on executing prompt engineering, testing, and debugging tasks for AI powered applications. The role supports the development and maintenance of AI chatbots and automation use cases under guidance from senior team members. Must Haves ● Strong written and verbal communication skills in English ● High attention to detail and quality ● Logical reasoning and structured thinking ● Ability to analyze text outputs and identify inconsistencies or logical gaps ● Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solution-oriented mindset ● Ability to learn new tools, workflows, and AI concepts quickly ● Comfort working in ambiguous and iterative environments ● Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Preferred backgrounds: Economics, English, Psychology, Marketing, Social Sciences) Preferred Skills ● Exposure to AI tools, chatbots, or LLM-based platforms ● Strong comprehension and critical analysis skills ● Ability to break down complex problems into structured evaluation scenarios ● Familiarity with structured documentation and reporting What You’ll Do ● Develop and iterate prompts for AI based applications. ● Test AI outputs across multiple scenarios, edge cases, and user journeys ● Identify prompt-level failures, hallucinations, and inconsistent behavior ● Analyze interaction logs and transcripts to improve bot accuracy ● Execute bulk testing using internal tools ● Document findings, improvements, and version updates clearly ● Collaborate with AI Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineers to implement improvements What We Expect From You ● High ownership and a proactive approach to solving problems ● Strong written clarity and ability to reason through ambiguity ● Comfort with fast-changing environments and an agile mindset ● Curiosity about AI systems and how large language models behave ● Structured thinking under pressure ● A mindset of continuous improvement and learning About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! To know more about us, our work, people, culture, values etc., check out navi.com/careers. Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/careers/values-at-navi to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact. About the Role At Navi, our technology teams build innovative, scalable and intelligent financial products. We leverage software engineering, data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence to solve complex problems across financial services. As an Engineer at Navi, you will solve real-world problems, build technology at scale and develop solutions that deliver measurable customer and business impact. Engineering team at Navi works across following areas: Software Engineering: Build & test scalable applications, backend services, world class Apps, UIs, APIs and distributed systems that delivers Navi's products to customers for powering 4 Billion transactions a month and growing by ~20% month on month. Data Science & Machine Learning: Apply advanced techniques across machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and Generative AI to solve complex business problems using diverse data. Develop predictive models and intelligent solutions, experiment with emerging approaches, and ensure robust model validation, production monitoring and continuous improvement. GenAI: Build innovative AI-powered applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and agentic AI to develop intelligent chatbots, automate complex workflows and solve real-world business problems. Experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate across teams and deliver scalable, reliable AI solutions that drive meaningful customer and business impact. Data & ML Platforms: Build scalable, cost-efficient infrastructure to collect, process and analyse data through batch and real-time pipelines, enabling self-serve capabilities across Analytics, Data Science and Product. Develop core ML infrastructure, including feature stores, automated training, model serving and real-time monitoring, alongside standalone feature-extraction applications that power Navi’s core technology. Collaborate and Learn: Work effectively across teams, exchange ideas, incorporate feedback and continuously strengthen your technical skills. Focus on Impact: Deliver solutions that improve customer experience, system performance, model effectiveness and business outcomes, while upholding the Navi OS. Strong programming fundamentals, proficiency in at least one programming language, and a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to break down complex problems, debug effectively, and develop clean, efficient and maintainable solutions. Strong learning agility, communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to take ownership and adapt to new technologies.

Job Description
Associate Product Manager I Location: Bengaluru About the Team Navi’s Product Team builds solutions that are simple, scalable, and centered on real user needs. The team strongly collaborates across functions—engineering, design, data, and business—to turn insight into impact. About the Role This role provides an opportunity for individuals with a foundational understanding of product analysis to contribute to data-driven decision-making and play a vital role in shaping the success of our products. The Product Analyst will work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and contribute to the overall product strategy. What We Expect From You Gather and analyze data to extract insights, providing valuable input for data-driven decision-making. Use SQL for efficient data querying and analysis. Identify and address product-related issues, relying on established procedures for basic problem-solving. Focus on user insights and data analysis for specific product features. Contribute to the understanding of product performance based on data-driven observations. Demonstrate basic awareness of design principles. Show a sense of good vs. bad design. Pay attention to detail in product analysis. Have basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Understand basic feature prioritization, typically guided by senior product management. Communicate clearly with all stakeholders, seeking help from managers in case of blockers or conflicts. Focus on data analysis and reporting to contribute to decision-making processes. Must Haves 0-2 years of relevant experience in product analysis or a related field. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data. Proficient in SQL for data querying and analysis. Basic understanding of user needs and product features. Basic awareness of design principles and the ability to distinguish good vs. bad design. Basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate findings and insights effectively. About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

companies.description:
As a Data Scientist I at Navi, the candidate will be responsible for developing and deploying scalable data science and AI-driven solutions across financial services, including lending, insurance, investments, UPI, collections, KYC and recommendation systems. The role involves end-to-end ownership of data science projects, from identifying business problems and building machine learning models to deployment, validation, monitoring and performance optimisation. Candidates will work with structured and unstructured data, including tabular, text, image and speech data, applying techniques in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Speech Recognition and Generative AI. Responsibilities also include exploring new algorithms, conducting experiments, extracting actionable insights and collaborating with Product, Engineering and Business teams to develop solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

About the company	Navi Limited is a digital-first financial services company on a mission to make finance simple for every Indian. As one of India’s fastest-growing financial destinations, Navi offers an easy-to-access suite of financial services (directly and through partners) including loans, insurance, mutual funds, and UPI payments. With hundreds of millions of users across the country, Navi combines in-house technology with deep consumer insight to create financial solutions that are intuitive, accessible, and reliable. Navi serves customers across their financial journeys with a single, integrated experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, Navi is committed to building a modern financial destination that is built on transparency, speed, and trust.

Job Description
As a Data Scientist I at Navi, the candidate will be responsible for developing and deploying scalable data science and AI-driven solutions across financial services, including lending, insurance, investments, UPI, collections, KYC and recommendation systems. The role involves end-to-end ownership of data science projects, from identifying business problems and building machine learning models to deployment, validation, monitoring and performance optimisation. Candidates will work with structured and unstructured data, including tabular, text, image and speech data, applying techniques in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Speech Recognition and Generative AI. Responsibilities also include exploring new algorithms, conducting experiments, extracting actionable insights and collaborating with Product, Engineering and Business teams to develop solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

companies.description:
The Applied Scientist at NoBroker.com / ConvoZen.AI will work on the research, development and deployment of advanced AI and data science products impacting millions of users. The role involves conducting research on state-of-the-art AI algorithms, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech-to-Text (STT) and Speech-to-Speech (STS) technologies. The candidate will design, build and deploy scalable end-to-end AI systems, including fine-tuning and optimisation of LLMs and multimodal models for real-time conversational AI applications. The role also involves analysing large and complex datasets to identify opportunities for automation and product optimisation, and collaborating with software engineers, product managers and research scientists to translate research into production-ready features. Candidates may also work on academic collaborations and research publications while leveraging generative AI, distributed systems and modern machine learning frameworks to develop robust and scalable AI solutions.

Job Description
The Applied Scientist at NoBroker.com / ConvoZen.AI will work on the research, development and deployment of advanced AI and data science products impacting millions of users. The role involves conducting research on state-of-the-art AI algorithms, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech-to-Text (STT) and Speech-to-Speech (STS) technologies. The candidate will design, build and deploy scalable end-to-end AI systems, including fine-tuning and optimisation of LLMs and multimodal models for real-time conversational AI applications. The role also involves analysing large and complex datasets to identify opportunities for automation and product optimisation, and collaborating with software engineers, product managers and research scientists to translate research into production-ready features. Candidates may also work on academic collaborations and research publications while leveraging generative AI, distributed systems and modern machine learning frameworks to develop robust and scalable AI solutions.

companies.description:
The AI for Research (AI4R) team leads BR in exploring and applying advanced AI and machine learning to generate novel drug-discovery insights and make discovery faster, smarter, and more focused on patients' needs. We partner directly with drug-discovery teams, raise AI expertise across BR, and stay at the frontier by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry. As an AI Specialist joining early in your career, you will design and build AI that helps discover tomorrow's medicines. You'll work alongside experienced AI engineers, ML-methods researchers, and rapid-prototyping builders on the same class of models and problems that define the field at the world's leading AI labs – but here, pointed at a goal that matters: real therapies for real patients. We don't yet know whether your strengths lean toward engineering robust systems, inventing new ML methods, rapidly building agentic AI workflows, or bridging AI with biology and chemistry to keep the science rigorous – and that's by design. We hire for talent, curiosity, and raw ability, and we will help you grow into where you shine.

We partner directly with drug-discovery teams, raise AI expertise across BR, and stay at the frontier by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry. You'll work alongside experienced AI engineers, ML-methods researchers, and rapid-prototyping builders on the same class of models and problems that define the field at the world's leading AI labs – but here, pointed at a goal that matters: real therapies for real patients. We don't yet know whether your strengths lean toward engineering robust systems, inventing new ML methods, rapidly building agentic AI workflows, or bridging AI with biology and chemistry to keep the science rigorous – and that's by design. companies.description:
About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. What you’ll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. You’ll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Models on robots: Get models running reliably and fast enough on real hardware. Debug failures in the lab across the model, the data, and the robot. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related branch Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, optimization, and machine learning Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or Tensorflow At least one serious ML project you can go deep on: a course project, internship, research, or something you built yourself. Preferred Publications in AI, open-source contributions, or strong competition results (Kaggle, robotics contests) Research or internship experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, or robotics Experience with post-training transformers, diffusion models, or multimodal models Experience with distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed) or GPU performance work (CUDA, profiling) Experience with data pipelines or large datasets (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet, WebDataset) Exposure to robot simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, PyBullet) or real robot hardware Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

Job Profile

Form Type	Designation	Cost to Company per year	Bond / Service Contract	Additional Criteria	CGPA Cut-off
PLACEMENT	Machine Learning Engineer, Robotic Foundation Models	3500000 INR			7.5

Job Description
About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. What you’ll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. You’ll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Models on robots: Get models running reliably and fast enough on real hardware. Debug failures in the lab across the model, the data, and the robot. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related branch Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, optimization, and machine learning Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or Tensorflow At least one serious ML project you can go deep on: a course project, internship, research, or something you built yourself. Preferred Publications in AI, open-source contributions, or strong competition results (Kaggle, robotics contests) Research or internship experience in deep learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, or robotics Experience with post-training transformers, diffusion models, or multimodal models Experience with distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed) or GPU performance work (CUDA, profiling) Experience with data pipelines or large datasets (object storage, Ray or Spark, Parquet, WebDataset) Exposure to robot simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, PyBullet) or real robot hardware Robotics clubs or competitions, or hardware hobby projects What we value Ownership. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

Job Description
About PhyAgents PhyAgents is a high-growth foundation model startup headquartered in San Jose, California. Founded by Stanford alumni, it sits at the intersection of the two biggest platform shifts of our time: foundation models and robotics. PhyAgents is backed by three Stanford professors, top AI leaders, and deep tech investors who run AI and compute at the top of the field. PhyAgents is building the Claude Code for Physical AI: a robotic foundation model plus a physical agentic framework for reliable, long-horizon operations in industrial environments. It delivers complete semi-humanoid robots as a workforce for industrial applications. Their “physical agents” (or robots) combine: a robotic foundation model, force-aware manipulation, long-horizon reasoning, step-by-step execution verified against real operating procedures, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. The robot plans the job, executes each step, checks their work, and when it isn’t certain it doesn't guess—it escalates. About the Team CEO and co-founder: Serial entrepreneur and former VP at Intel. Previously raised >$50M, scaled and exited a robotics company. PhD from Stanford. CTO and co-founder: Key foundation models leader from Apple. Previously led perception for self-driving. MS from Stanford, B.Tech from IIT Madras. The team includes executives and AI leaders from Apple, Intel, Marvell, Samsung, Uber, Panasonic and Lockheed Martin. Why join now You’ll be among the first engineers in the India team of a Silicon Valley deep tech startup. You’ll work on the same problems, with the same bar, as our team in San Jose. This is not a satellite office working off tickets. The India team is a core part of how we build models, data, and infrastructure, and you’ll own real pieces of the stack from your first quarter. Most new grads join a large company and work on one small corner of a mature product. Here you’ll work across the whole stack, contribute at the cutting edge, see your code move a robot, and grow as fast as the company does. The field has shown broad competence across many tasks, and almost never 99.9% reliability on even one. That gap is the company. Closing it takes models that learn from demonstration and improve through practice, a data flywheel that turns every failure into training signal, and software that runs on real robots in real industrial environments. About the role At PhyAgents, a machine learning engineer works across the full loop that makes a robot better: data, models, training, simulation, evaluation, and deployment on real hardware. You’ll do research-grade work and ship it onto robots in the same quarter. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. What you’ll work on Training and post-training: Train and post-train robotic foundation models, including vision-language-action models, using imitation learning and reinforcement learning. You’ll own the work from data loading through multi-GPU training runs. Training infrastructure: Build and scale distributed multi-node GPU training, data loaders that keep GPUs fed, and reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking. Simulation: Build simulation environments for our tasks. Train policies with reinforcement learning that transfer to real robots. Rewards and verifiers: Design the reward functions and the verifiers that check whether a task step actually succeeded. Evaluation: Build harnesses that tell us whether a model actually got better, in simulation and on real hardware. Design the metrics that decide what ships. Data and data infrastructure: Define what data the models need. Build the pipelines that turn raw robot episodes into versioned, training-ready datasets. Trace a stuck policy back to its data. Models on robots: Get models running reliably and fast enough on real hardware. Debug failures in the lab across the model, the data, and the robot. What we’re looking for Minimum B.Tech, M.Tech or PhD (graduating 2027) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related branch Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, optimization, and machine learning Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems Fluency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch or Tensorflow At least one serious ML project you can go deep on: a course project, internship, research, or something you built yourself. You finish things. A result that doesn’t run on the robot isn’t finished. Rigor. You catch the subtle bug that the dashboard says is fine. Range. You’re as willing to debug a data pipeline or a ROS node as a training run. Comfort with real hardware. Our models run on robots, and you’ll spend time in the lab. Speed of learning. There’s no playbook. You’ll be learning new parts of the stack every month. Ambition. You want to build something that matters at the frontier of AI and robotics. Clear communication. You’ll work daily across San Jose, Bengaluru, and our data operations team in Nepal.

Job Description
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services. ROLE PURPOSE We are hiring for the role of Software Engineer. This is an Individual Contributor role reporting into the Senior Engineering Manager. In your role, you'll be instrumental in advancing our mission by delivering on the end-to-end application, functionality and features as per the project requirements and priorities. You will also be entrusted with ensuring that every feature and functionality of the application is designed, developed, and integrated according to the specified goals and timeline. The responsibilities we entrust you with • Understand the design and project architecture and perform coding and unit testing in accordance with the design and architecture • Understand the issues being reported, analyse the logs and resolve the technical issues through debugging and root cause analysis. • Analyse the trends in issues being reported and troubleshoot issues to determine depth of issues and severity, investigate potential workarounds and take required actions as per defined SLAs • Work with testing team to review test cases, explore opportunities for automation • Document code consistently, analysis findings and benchmark performance as per defined standards • Provide support in the maintenance of test automation scripts and enhancing existing automation scripts to cover the new functionalities WHAT MATTERS IN THIS ROLE • Years of work experience: 0-2 years of experience in software development, including internships. • Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science (CSE), Information Technology (IT) Experience with Web Services: Consuming or creating web services using REST, MQTT, or Web Sockets. Containerization: Working knowledge of Docker, Rocket, and container orchestrators like Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud services and resources in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Programming and Design: Strong understanding of SOA, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and multi-threaded application development. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Understanding of basic concepts such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Ability to implement simple class structures and relationships. Data Structures (DS) & Algorithms: Familiarity with fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic operations (insertion, deletion, traversal). Source Code Management: Proficiency in Git or similar distributed SCM tools. WHAT WE VALUE IN OUR PEOPLE : You are the CEO of what you do: You show ownership and make things happen. You own tomorrow: You build solutions for the merchants and do the right thing. You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do.

Job Description
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services. ROLE PURPOSE We are hiring for the role of Software Engineer. This is an Individual Contributor role reporting into the Senior Engineering Manager. In your role, you'll be instrumental in advancing our mission by delivering on the end-to-end application, functionality and features as per the project requirements and priorities. You will also be entrusted with ensuring that every feature and functionality of the application is designed, developed, and integrated according to the specified goals and timeline. The responsibilities we entrust you with • Understand the design and project architecture and perform coding and unit testing in accordance with the design and architecture • Understand the issues being reported, analyse the logs and resolve the technical issues through debugging and root cause analysis. • Analyse the trends in issues being reported and troubleshoot issues to determine depth of issues and severity, investigate potential workarounds and take required actions as per defined SLAs • Work with testing team to review test cases, explore opportunities for automation • Document code consistently, analysis findings and benchmark performance as per defined standards • Provide support in the maintenance of test automation scripts and enhancing existing automation scripts to cover the new functionalities WHAT MATTERS IN THIS ROLE • Years of work experience: 0-2 years of experience in software development, including internships. • Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science (CSE), Information Technology (IT) Experience with Web Services: Consuming or creating web services using REST, MQTT, or Web Sockets. Containerization: Working knowledge of Docker, Rocket, and container orchestrators like Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud services and resources in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Programming and Design: Strong understanding of SOA, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and multi-threaded application development. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Understanding of basic concepts such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Ability to implement simple class structures and relationships. Data Structures (DS) & Algorithms: Familiarity with fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic operations (insertion, deletion, traversal). Source Code Management: Proficiency in Git or similar distributed SCM tools. WHAT WE VALUE IN OUR PEOPLE : You are the CEO of what you do: You show ownership and make things happen. You own tomorrow: You build solutions for the merchants and do the right thing. You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do.

About the company	Plutus Research is an algorithmic trading firm with sophisticated trading algorithms built on advanced mathematical techniques at its heart. We specialize in developing these automated trading strategies based on continuous research being done drawing from the concepts of machine learning, financial engineering and derivatives pricing theory. The company is one of the fastest growing high frequency trading firms in India and has a significant market share in Indian cash and derivatives markets. The company looks forward to expanding into global markets as well. With a startup-like spirit and a stability of an experienced firm, we, at Plutus Research, offer you a unique opportunity where you can advance your career with limitless possibilities of learning and growing in the field of quantitative research, trading and low latency infrastructure development.

About the company	Plutus Research is an algorithmic trading firm with sophisticated trading algorithms built on advanced mathematical techniques at its heart. We specialize in developing these automated trading strategies based on continuous research being done drawing from the concepts of machine learning, financial engineering and derivatives pricing theory. The company is one of the fastest growing high frequency trading firms in India and has a significant market share in Indian cash and derivatives markets. The company looks forward to expanding into global markets as well. With a startup-like spirit and a stability of an experienced firm, we, at Plutus Research, offer you a unique opportunity where you can advance your career with limitless possibilities of learning and growing in the field of quantitative research, trading and low latency infrastructure development.
